verdict.rationale: monday's developer docs explicitly support building custom board/item views, dashboard widgets, and full-page apps, with a 'Vibe' React component library designed to 'look native instantly' (monday-docs-3, monday-docs-4), directly matching the story. However, this is entirely vendor-documentation evidence with no independent/community confirmation of actual native-feel quality, and general community sentiment on the platform's UI/UX is quite negative, so confidence in the developer-facing polish is limited.
